```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(ggplot2)
library(randomForest)
library(ROCR)
library(caret)

```

Loading file
```{r}
gene_exp <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/gene_exp.RData")
pt_status <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_status.RData")
pt_char <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/pt_char.RData")
```
Splitting by cohort and outcome

```{r}
source("../rf_functions.R")
```


#Creating objects for runs
```{r}
full_list <- colnames(gene_exp)[2:length(gene_exp)]
clin_list <- colnames(pt_char)[2:length(pt_char)]
bor_list <- c("TNF", "CDKN2A (ARF)", "IL-2", "BCL6", "NECTIN2")
greedy_list <- c("TNF", "CDKN2A (ARF)", "IL-2", "IL-21", "KLRG1", "SPN") 
logr_list <- c("IL-21", "AHR", "B3GAT1") 



#Unshuffled 
seed_list <- c(12345:12369)
#Shuffled
run_number <- 1:1000
seed_list_r <- c(12345:13344)

nullmodel <- full_join(gene_exp, pt_char)
null_list <- colnames(nullmodel)[2:length(nullmodel)]
```




#Adj tox null model
```{r}
rf_tox_nullmodel_random <- shuffled_rf(seed_list,
                                        "Therapy complete",
                                        "Toxicity",
                                        pt_status,
                                        nullmodel,
                                        "Adj_Exp",
                                        "Adj_Val",
                                        null_list
)



saveRDS(rf_tox_nullmodel_random, file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_nullmodel_random.RData")

```



#Adj tox logr
```{r}
#running predictive model
rf_tox_logr <- kTest(seed_list,
                     "Therapy complete",
                     "Toxicity",
                     "Model",
                     pt_status,
                     gene_exp,
                     "Adj_Exp",
                     "Adj_Val",
                     logr_list) 


saveRDS(rf_tox_logr, file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_logr.RData")



tox.logr <- met.p.calc(rf_tox_nullmodel_random,
                        "Toxicity",
                       rf_tox_logr)


metric_graph(rf_tox_nullmodel_random,
             "Toxicity",
             rf_tox_logr)
```

```{r}
rf_tox_nullmodel_random <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_nullmodel_random.RData")
rf_tox_clinical <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_clinical.RData")
rf_tox_fullpanel <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_fullpanel.RData")
rf_tox_boruta <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_boruta.RData")
rf_tox_greedylist <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_greedylist.RData")
rf_tox_logr <-  readRDS(file = "../Outputs/rf_tox_logr.RData")


```



#F1 graph
```{r}
f1.graph(rf_tox_nullmodel_random,
         rf_tox_clinical,
         rf_tox_fullpanel,
         rf_tox_boruta,
         rf_tox_greedylist, 
         rf_tox_logr, 
         "Toxicity")

ggsave("../figures/rf_tox_f1graph.png", width = 12, height = 5)

```
